purpose: Audit the fresh official/institutional secondary-research sweep for Centru, Sud-Muntenia and Sud-Vest Oltenia without promoting project activity, funding supply or technology deployment as evidence of AI4WORK need prevalence.

screened_candidates.title: Două noi contracte pentru digitalizarea administrației publice locale din județul Alba
screened_candidates.observed_fact: Two new public-administration digitalisation contracts are reported for Alba county localities under Programul Regiunea Centru.
screened_candidates.reason: Funding/implementation activity; it does not measure adult or employer AI/digital-skills need prevalence, sampling frame, respondent distribution or unmet training demand.

screened_candidates.title: Proiecte europene pentru administrații publice locale mai conectate cu cetățenii din Municipiile Brașov și Codlea și orașul Zărnești
screened_candidates.observed_fact: Current public-sector projects include AI, Digital Twin and e-government components.
screened_candidates.reason: Technology investment/implementation is not a population measure of skills need and cannot substitute for target-population research.

screened_candidates.title: Conferința FIT EDIH Future-Ready: direcțiile transformării digitale în Regiunea Centru pentru perioada 2026–2029
screened_candidates.observed_fact: Institutional stakeholders convened to assess digital-transformation programmes and define 2026-2029 directions.
screened_candidates.reason: Strategic/event context does not add a stronger target-population prevalence measure beyond registered Centru evidence, including S37.

screened_candidates.title: Start preselecției pentru apelul pilot de inovare destinat IMM-urilor din regiunea Sud-Muntenia
screened_candidates.observed_fact: ADR reports launch of preselection for an SME innovation pilot whose stated purpose includes measuring effects of funding programmes on entrepreneurship, innovation and competitiveness.
screened_candidates.reason: This is a pilot launch/preselection, not published outcome evidence on AI4WORK adult/employer skills-needs prevalence.

screened_candidates.title: ADR Sud Muntenia a deschis la Ploiești seria regională de focus grupuri pentru descoperire antreprenorială
screened_candidates.observed_fact: A 40-participant multi-stakeholder focus group was held as part of entrepreneurial-discovery work and discussion of innovation/advanced-technology opportunities.
screened_candidates.reason: Stakeholder consultation/event composition is not a probability sample of AI4WORK adults or employers and the page does not publish a need-prevalence instrument/result suitable for H1-H5.

screened_candidates.title: Fonduri pentru formare profesională
screened_candidates.observed_fact: PTJ funding is available for employment/training-service providers in Dolj and Gorj.
screened_candidates.reason: Funding eligibility, budgets and training supply are project/policy activity, not evidence that a specific AI/digital-skills need exists or its prevalence.

screened_candidates.title: CD Future - Competențe digitale, un viitor performant pentru firma ta prin angajați competitivi
screened_candidates.observed_fact: The project targets development/updating of employees' digital skills in Sud-Muntenia and Sud-Vest Oltenia during 2025-2027.
screened_candidates.reason: A project's stated objective and training activity cannot be used as proof of underlying need; no target-population prevalence estimate is published on this page.

screened_candidates.title: Lansare proiect
screened_candidates.observed_fact: A transition-support project in Dolj targets active employment, vocational training and workforce adaptation measures.
screened_candidates.reason: Target counts, project objectives and service delivery are activity/supply evidence and do not measure AI4WORK skills-needs prevalence.

refresh_conclusion: The fresh official/institutional sweep found current digitalisation, innovation and training activity in all three target regions but no newly published candidate that improves on the registered evidence with a defensible direct 2026 AI4WORK adult/employer target-population need-prevalence measure. No source is promoted solely for recency. Existing S01-S37 remain the source-register set for this refresh, and all registered secondary evidence remains non-numeric for H1-H5 under the source-register contract.
next_refresh_rule: Promote a new source only if it provides materially stronger evidence relevant to the target populations, with enough provenance and sampling/method detail to classify its limits. Otherwise record the screen without inflating the source register.
